project.title: Field Service Workflow Standardisation for Repair Operations
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardised workflow for in-home and workshop repairs to reduce rework, improve scheduling, and increase customer satisfaction.
deliverables: End-to-end standard operating procedure for field and workshop repairs
Standard diagnostic and repair checklists for appliances, tools, and electronics
Shared scheduling and job allocation process for movers and technicians
Customer communication and follow-up guidelines for all service visits
Pilot results report with KPIs and improvement recommendations
constraints: All procedures must fit within existing tools and paper forms used in the workshops
New workflow must not increase average repair time per job by more than 10%
Compliance with safety regulations for electrical and lifting operations
Minimal disruption to ongoing customer appointments during rollout
Standardisation must work for both on-site and workshop-based repairs

risks.risk: Technicians resist adopting new checklists and procedures.
risks.mitigation: Involve technicians in drafting SOPs, run short training sessions, and collect feedback during pilot.

risks.risk: Scheduling changes cause missed or delayed appointments.
risks.mitigation: Pilot new scheduling process on a limited route first and keep a fallback to the old schedule method.

risks.risk: Standard workflow does not fit special or complex repair cases.
risks.mitigation: Include an exception handling section in SOP and capture edge cases during pilot for refinement.

risks.risk: Insufficient data to measure impact on rework and customer satisfaction.
risks.mitigation: Define a minimal data capture template and ensure all pilot jobs are logged consistently.

themes.why_relevant: Reduces misdiagnosis and rework across appliance, tool, and electronics repairs.
Aligns movers and technicians to minimise travel time and missed visits.
Ensures consistent updates on arrival times, quotes, and follow-ups.
Critical for electrical work, lifting heavy items, and on-site installations.
Validates that the new workflow actually improves service quality.

backlog.task: Map current end-to-end repair workflows for home appliances, power tools, electronics, and telecom installs
definition_of_done: Process maps created for each service type
Pain points and bottlenecks documented
Reviewed and validated with at least one technician from each area

backlog.task: Draft standard diagnostic checklist for household appliance repairs
definition_of_done: Checklist covers intake, safety, diagnostic, repair, and testing steps
Includes fields for parts used and estimated vs actual time
Reviewed and approved by project manager

backlog.task: Create standard diagnostic and repair checklist for power tools
definition_of_done: Checklist includes visual inspection, electrical tests, and functional tests
Version adapted for both corded and battery tools
Pilot-ready version shared with all power tool technicians

backlog.task: Define standard procedure for telecom and consumer electronics service visits
definition_of_done: Procedure covers pre-visit checks, installation/repair, and signal testing
Includes logging requirements for readings and configurations
Aligned with safety and regulatory requirements

backlog.task: Design shared scheduling and job allocation rules for movers and technicians
definition_of_done: Rules defined for time slots, travel buffers, and load limits
Mover and technician constraints documented
Scenario examples tested for typical daily routes

backlog.task: Specify standard handling and transport procedure for heavy or fragile equipment
definition_of_done: Checklist for packing, lifting, and securing items created
Includes coordination steps with technicians on-site
Reviewed for compliance with safety guidelines

backlog.task: Create customer communication and follow-up guidelines for all service types
definition_of_done: Templates for pre-visit, on-site, and post-visit communication drafted
Guidelines cover quotes, delays, and next steps
Technician feedback incorporated and final version approved

backlog.task: Consolidate all procedures into a single field service SOP document
definition_of_done: SOP includes sections for each service type and shared rules
Version control and review history documented
SOP shared with all stakeholders for pilot

backlog.task: Run pilot of new workflow with selected technicians and movers
definition_of_done: Pilot scope, duration, and participants defined
All pilot jobs logged using new checklists
Issues and improvement ideas collected

backlog.task: Collect and summarise pilot metrics and feedback
definition_of_done: Data on rework, time per job, and missed appointments compiled
Technician and customer feedback summarised
Recommendations for adjustments documented

backlog.task: Refine diagnostic checklists based on pilot results
definition_of_done: Redundant steps removed and missing checks added
Updated versions validated by at least two technicians
Change log recorded in SOP

backlog.task: Plan full rollout and training sessions for all field staff
definition_of_done: Training agenda and materials prepared
Rollout schedule agreed with operations
Communication sent to all affected staff

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current workflows and main pain points across all service types.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message from project manager sharing A1 draft workflow maps.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the top three pain points to address in the first version of the SOP.
Confirm which service types are in scope for the initial pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and iterate on diagnostic checklists for appliances and power tools.
threads_plan.trigger: Project manager posts first versions of A2 and A3 asking for technician feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the minimum required steps for appliance diagnostics checklist A2.
Approve the minimum required steps for power tool checklist A3.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on telecom/electronics visit SOP and safety/handling procedures.
threads_plan.trigger: Telecommunications technician shares draft A4 and mover shares inputs for A6.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on telecom and electronics service visit SOP A4 for pilot use.
Approve handling and transport safety checklist A6.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in scheduling rules and customer communication approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Project manager posts proposal for A5 and A7 based on mapped workflows.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on scheduling and job allocation rules A5 for the pilot routes.
Approve customer communication playbook A7 for all pilot jobs.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan pilot, review results, and confirm adjustments before rollout.
threads_plan.trigger: Project manager shares A8 draft with pilot metrics and recommendations.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Reconfirm the top three pain points were addressed or define next iteration scope.
Confirm final version of power tool checklist A3 for full rollout.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each participant posts yesterday's progress, today's focus, and blockers.
Twice-weekly checklist review thread to discuss issues found using new checklists.
Weekly pilot metrics update summarising job counts, rework, and notable incidents.
Pre-weekend planning post to align on next week's appointments and any process changes.
